topic: how archerfish compensate for refraction while targeting prey

continuity_bible.environment: one shallow mangrove tank with the same branch, waterline, and single insect above it
continuity_bible.lighting: dappled daylight from upper left with stable caustics below the surface
continuity_bible.color_treatment: natural olive water, silver fish, dark mangrove wood, restrained amber trajectory accents

factual_notes.claim: Archerfish shoot water jets to dislodge aerial prey.
factual_notes.source_title: Archerfish actively control the hydrodynamics of their jets

factual_notes.claim: They can account for the optical displacement caused by refraction at the water surface.
factual_notes.source_title: Visual processing and target selection in archerfish

script_segments.narration: This fish hits a target above water even though the surface makes it appear displaced.
script_segments.caption: THE TARGET IS NOT WHERE IT LOOKS
script_segments.visual_action: A split-level view holds fish below and insect above while one apparent ray bends
script_segments.entry_action: Open on the insect reflection rippling
script_segments.exit_action: End as the fish settles beneath the branch
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: Light changes direction when it crosses from air into water, shifting the insect's apparent position.
script_segments.caption: THE SURFACE BENDS LIGHT
script_segments.visual_action: Clean rays from the insect bend at the same waterline toward the same fish
script_segments.exit_action: Converge rays at the fish's eye
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: The archerfish learns the relationship between what it sees and where the target really is.
script_segments.caption: VISION BECOMES A MAP
script_segments.visual_action: The fish holds position while a restrained true-position marker separates from the apparent position
script_segments.exit_action: Fish rotates its body into firing posture
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: Then its mouth shapes a fast water jet aimed through the surface.
script_segments.caption: A WATER JET FIRES
script_segments.visual_action: One continuous high-speed shot shows the mouth jet crossing the waterline
script_segments.exit_action: Follow the jet toward the insect
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: The jet strengthens toward the front, concentrating the impact near the target.
script_segments.caption: THE IMPACT CONCENTRATES
script_segments.visual_action: Macro slow motion follows later water catching the leading jet just before impact
script_segments.exit_action: Insect releases from branch without distress
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: It is not a lucky shot. The fish combines optics, learned calibration, and precise fluid control.
script_segments.caption: OPTICS + CONTROL
script_segments.visual_action: The insect lands on the surface and the same fish turns toward it in one natural motion
script_segments.exit_action: End before feeding on a clean water ripple
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed
